New AI Camera Studio

Scan Any Physical Card with Your Camera

Found a card you love at an exhibition or received one from family? Hold it up to your device camera or upload a photo. We automatically extract its color palette and artwork to build an instant editable multi-page suite — including matching Inside Pages and Baraat visiting cards.

Real-time viewfinder
Auto foil & tone extraction
6-Page Suite + Baraat Pass
Works with iPhone, Android, or laptop webcam
Effortless & Completely Self-Service

How Card Assist Works

We eliminated the endless email chains and manual revisions. You are in complete artistic control.

1

Choose Your Design

Browse our curated gallery of 12 royal and modern Indian wedding templates. Filter by faith (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh), style (Traditional, Minimal, Floral), or budget.

Browse Templates
2

Customise in Studio

Personalise bride & groom names, auspicious timings, venue, and multi-day itinerary. Select authentic religious shlokas, tweak fonts, and preview front & back in 3D.

Real-time Instant Preview
3

Submit & Print

Select your paper GSM, hot gold foil finishes, and matching envelopes. Review the proof PDF, confirm spelling, and we dispatch museum-grade invitations to your doorstep.

300 DPI Vector PDF Included
